title: Concept: Repository restricted to snapshots
description: build.gradle declares a repository that serves only snapshot artifacts, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository that serves only snapshot artifacts.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository that serves only snapshot artifacts.
